messages.content: You are helping a product manager improve a product requirements document.

{"initialBody": "Product managers can lose work while drafting review documents.", "userInstruction": "Rewrite only the present user problem and consequence. Include the interview base, observed loss, and reconstruction cost. Exclude goals, solutions, rollout, and unsupported business claims.", "evidence": "# Draft recovery research

Twelve working product managers were interviewed in June 2026.

Eight of the twelve participants lost unsaved PRD work during the previous 30 days.

Those participants estimated a mean reconstruction time of 23 minutes per incident.

No adoption volume, market size, or revenue effect has been validated.

A recovered draft must reopen within 10 seconds."}
